name: road_segment
description: Straight road segment: cambered crown (路拱), side ditches (边沟), and a center-to-edge material gradient with deterministic per-column noise so the pavement never looks machine-uniform.
when_to_use: Any road/path between builds. Chain multiple segments for longer roads; origin = one end of the road centerline at ground level (use the terrain summary to keep y realistic per segment).

origin.notes: start end of the road at ground level (min corner)

direction.notes: x = runs east, z = runs south

surface_materials.notes: noise mix for the mid lanes

fill_material.notes: one block under every surface block
